caption: A ball rolls from a sunlit pavement into the shade of a building, and its shadow disappears.

sa.check: A ball rolls along a pavement.
It rolls into the shade of a building.
The pavement is sunlit before the shade.
The ball enters the shade first and the shadow disappears with it.

pc.expect: The shadow is visible while the ball is in the sun and fades as it enters the shade.
pc.fail: The shadow stays visible in the shade; or it is missing in sunlight; or it vanishes before the ball reaches the shade.

pc.expect: The ball itself is unchanged as it enters the shade.
pc.fail: The ball vanishes; or a second ball appears; or the ball changes as it enters the shade.

pc.expect: In sunlight the shadow lies on the side away from the sun, attached at the contact point.
pc.fail: It lies toward the sun; or is detached; or switches sides.

pc.expect: The ball rolls straight and slows gently.
pc.fail: It curves; or speeds up; or stops and restarts.
A second shadow appears in sunlight; or the shadow becomes solid; or the ball passes through the wall.

pc.expect: The ball's colour and the pavement stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the building changes.
